answer: The comet test I would run is Filed sports commentator licence with sports broadcasters attestation: a licence broadcasters renew after match audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a licence broadcasters renew after match audits stays private; the glacier is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the fable of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
